flags.why: Gián hoặc expresses uncertainty ('perhaps; maybe'), rather than a condition ('if by chance; in case'), as shown in this [dictionary entry](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-gi%C3%A1n%20ho%E1%BA%B7c).

Gié denotes a rice panicle or a branch of it, whereas a spikelet is a different botanical structure ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-gi%C3%A9), [rice research](https://iasvn.org/storage/uploads/files/9TWGVPL7N0Cau%20truc%20bong%20lua.pdf)).
flags.fix: rice panicle; grain-bearing branch of a rice panicle

flags.why: The example describes bending gié lúa, which are rice panicles rather than individual spikelets ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-gi%C3%A9)).
flags.fix: The ripe golden rice panicles bend downward.
